policies.B1: Aerial equipment achieves high-altitude rating when its maximum service ceiling reaches or exceeds 4,000 meters.
policies.B2: A vehicle receives extreme climate designation provided it has an approved high-altitude rating.
policies.B3: Severe weather clearance is granted to hardware demonstrating extreme climate designation.
policies.B4: An item secures defense deployment status if it holds severe weather clearance.
policies.D1: Cataloging for remote surveillance programs requires defense deployment status along with a transmission distance of at least 10 kilometers.
policies.B5: A filtration unit gains eco-certification if its daily purified volume reaches 500 liters or more.
policies.B6: Solar hardware is approved for exterior deployment provided it possesses an IP67 weatherproof rating.
policies.B7: Personal mobility devices qualify for heavy-duty commuter classification when peak motor output is at least 500 watts.

decoy_policies: Commercial transport trailers are granted priority logistics routing when maximum payload capacity exceeds 10,000 kilograms.
Industrial heat pumps receive energy efficiency endorsement if seasonal performance factor is at least 4.0.

B6: Solis Solar Panel Kit maintains an IP67 weatherproof rating, satisfying the credential needed for outdoor installation.
